repos.name: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
repos.description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
repos.one_liner: An open-source autonomous agent designed to automate CI/CD reliability and infrastructure management.
bullets: Built with Python to integrate directly into existing CI/CD pipelines.
Acts as an intelligent agent to monitor, diagnose, and remediate infrastructure incidents.
Reduces manual toil for DevOps teams by automating routine SRE tasks and deployment health checks.
Focuses on observability and automated recovery to ensure high-availability production environments.
repos.img_alt: OpenSRE CLI welcome screen with the sign-in prompt

repos.name: context-dot-dev/enrichable
repos.description: Open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment. Build lead lists from a prompt, research every row with live web data, and find work emails. Powered by Context.dev.
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered spreadsheet tool designed for automated data enrichment and lead generation.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture that integrates LLM reasoning with structured spreadsheet data.
Automates the research process by performing live web lookups for every row in a dataset.
Ideal for sales and marketing professionals needing to build verified lead lists and find professional contact information.
Leverages prompt-based workflows to transform raw data into actionable business intelligence.

repos.name: simplexai-labs/linger
repos.description: Linger is An Open-Source Personal Agent That Runs Fully on Your PC.  We aim to break Big Tech’s grip on AI by bringing powerful local AI to everyday computers through efficient model–harness co-design, so everyone can run their own.
repos.one_liner: A fully local, open-source personal AI agent designed to run efficiently on consumer hardware.
bullets: TypeScript-based implementation focusing on model-hardware co-design for maximum efficiency.
Prioritizes data privacy by keeping all agentic processing and model inference on the local machine.
Enables users to break dependency on centralized Big Tech AI services for personal automation.
Suitable for users requiring a persistent, private agent that can interact with local files and applications.

repos.name: jiangmuran/vibepanel
repos.description: A web console for running many parallel coding-agent sessions. tmux keeps the processes alive; the browser owns organisation, naming, state and ordering.
repos.one_liner: A web-based orchestration console for managing multiple parallel coding-agent sessions.
bullets: Go-based backend that leverages tmux for robust process management and persistence.
Provides a centralized browser interface to organize, name, and monitor state across various agentic coding tasks.
Solves the 'agent sprawl' problem by allowing developers to run and track multiple autonomous coding sessions simultaneously.
Essential for power users building complex software systems using multi-agent workflows.

repos.name: haydenschmitty/floorplan
repos.description: See how your app actually fits together. An interactive, plain-English map of your codebase, drawn by Claude or Codex.
repos.one_liner: An interactive visualization tool that maps your codebase architecture using LLMs.
bullets: JavaScript-based tool that utilizes Claude or Codex to parse and interpret complex repository structures.
Generates plain-English, interactive maps that explain how different modules and services fit together.
Accelerates onboarding for new developers and helps architects visualize technical debt or dependency bottlenecks.
Provides a high-level overview of infrastructure and code flow, making it easier to manage large-scale projects.
